title: Stepwise volatilization induced by nature-sourced volatile solid additives improving the efficiency and stability of perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,6260-6272
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03897E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jeewon Park, Seoyoung Kim, Wonjun Kim, Zhe Sun, Byongkyu Lee, Changduk Yang
Nature-sourced volatile solid additives, camphor (CP) and camphorquinone (CQ), enable high-performance perovskite solar cells. CQ shows stepwise volatilization, achieving PCE of 25.0% and >90% stability after 1000 h, highlighting green processing.
